senses.gloss: मौञ्ज mauñjá, a. (ī́) made of Muñja grass: 🞄-bandhana, n. investiture with the girdle of 🞄Muñja grass.

मौञ्जिन् mauñj-in, a. wearing a girdle of 🞄Muñja grass;
 -īya, a. made of Muñja grass.

मौञ्जी mauñj-ī, f. (sts. i metr.;
 sc. mekhalā) 🞄girdle of Muñja grass: -nibandhana, n. investiture 🞄with the girdle of Muñja grass.
मौञ्ज्य mauñj-ya, m. kind of personification.
